completed_stage_receipts.summary: Confirmed two linked defects: a tentative user idea/question was inferred as implementation authority, and unprotected-main risk was overclassified using the wrong multi-writer threat model.
Classified USER_PROPOSAL_INFERRED_AS_DECISION_OR_CANONICAL_MECHANISM as recurrent and DIRECT_MAIN_THREAT_MODEL_MISCLASSIFICATION as first-observed.
Mapped hot-path routing, maintenance semantics, durable commit receipts, writer lease, GitHub main authority and external mutation primitives.

Existing cold-path candidate semantics had already been accepted, so recurrence escalates to a minimal hot-path entry invariant plus regression; direct-main repair moves to mutation-integrity semantics rather than branch workflow.
External scouting not required: the failure is internal and current first-party connector primitives provide the needed HEAD-level CAS mechanism.
Reuse existing hot-path entrypoint and commit-observability owner; create no new root policy, registry or permanent agent.
Rejected no-change because the failure recurred; rejected mandatory PR-first as mismatched complexity; accepted independent-assessment hot-path rule plus direct-main HEAD CAS.
Resolved retrievable facts: SINGLE_ACTIVE_CHAT writer model, current lease, unprotected main, and available expected-sha ref update. No user architecture choice remains.

Escalate only the recurrent anti-canonicalization invariant to ENTRYPOINT; keep detailed semantics in existing maintenance policy and place direct-main commit integrity in the existing progress/commit policy.
Minimal design adds one hot-path rule, one commit-integrity section and focused regression without PR lifecycle or new authorities.
The repair preserves direct main, removes the erroneous HIGH-by-default branch-protection framing, and increases concurrency safety with HEAD CAS at lower operational cost than PR-first.

Re-completed implementation after both reopen findings: the anti-inference rule remains hot-path and within budget; direct-main HEAD-CAS remains the operational contract; SYSTEM_BLUEPRINT now states the SINGLE_ACTIVE_CHAT threat model; HANDOFF no longer treats unprotected main as a HIGH defect or PR-first as default; the experimental PR-first branch remains unmerged and non-authoritative.
